findings.label: Period param plumbing
findings.detail: demoResourceChange adds a fourth period? argument beyond the task's stated signature (resourceId, service?, region?), and the router passes param(url,'period'). This is a sensible improvement the plan calls for and is test-covered with period=2026-08; flagged only as a literal deviation from the signature in the task text. No change required unless the three-argument signature is contractual.
